content:
olivia_sales: Quick ask — NovaHealth POC kicks off Tues. They want a hosted API key but with strict rotation: 5-day TTL, IP allowlist for their test runner, and an easy revoke path for their security team. Can we do that for a 3-week POC?

marc_se: Yep. We can create an API key with expires_in set to 432000 (5d) and attach allowed_ips. Recommend scopes limited to inference:generate and embeddings only.

anya_security: Confirming constraints: hosted keys ok for non-PHI test traffic only. Controls we need: short TTL (5d ok), audit events enabled, listed owner contact, and explicit IP allowlist if requested. If they plan to send PHI, we must switch to Private — we already told them that.

kevin_infra: I can provision via admin API. Sample payload (admin-only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/api-keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"nova-poc-ephemeral","scopes":["inference:generate","embeddings:create"],"expires_in":432000,"allowed_ips":["18.205.93.0/24"],"metadata":{"owner":"olivia_sales","customer":"novahealth","poc":"3w"}}'
```
I'll set audit=true and attach owner email.

olivia_sales: Can you include a field so the customer can request immediate revoke via an API call? They want to trigger revocation from their security portal.

kevin_infra: There is a revoke endpoint (admin only). We can expose a signed webhook token for NovaHealth to call our proxy which will call the revoke endpoint. That proxy verifies a one-time HMAC and then posts to /admin/api-keys/<id>/revoke. We'll log the request and alert security ops.

jen_support: I'll add instructions to the POC runbook and include the proxy webhook URL + HMAC setup. Also add the rotation playbook: 1) create replacement key, 2) update client config (we recommend env var swap), 3) revoke old key. Put sample rotation script in the runbook.

marc_se: Small script snippet I'll share:
```bash
# rotate
new_key=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/api-keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{...}' | jq -r .key)
# update service env (example)
curl -X POST https://ci.example.com/update -d "API_KEY=$new_key"
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/api-keys/$old_id/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
This avoids downtime if you create before revoke.

anya_security: Also ensure we email audit trail and revoke events to security@redwood.ai and to NovaHealth contact. Add retention notes: hosted POC logs kept 90 days.

prov-bot: API key created: id=ak_2026nhabc, name=nova-poc-ephemeral, expires_at=1815034923, allowed_ips=[18.205.93.0/24], created_by=kevin_infra

olivia_sales: Got it — shared key OOB with the customer's infra lead. Jen, please attach rotation script + webhook instructions to the POC doc and set a calendar reminder for rotate every 5 days. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
